items.distractor_fact: Σε γειτονικό χωριό ο σταθμός καταγραφής σημείωσε {D}°C το ίδιο βράδυ.
items.gloss_en: In a neighboring village the recording station registered {D}°C the same evening.
items.entity_note: belongs to a different village's weather station, not the story's own thermometer

items.entity_note: belongs to a different reservoir, not the one whose level the question asks about
